# Golden Horse Award for Best Original Film Score

}}
The Golden Horse Award for Best Original Film Score () is presented annually at Taiwan's Golden Horse Film Awards. The latest ceremony was held on November 22, 2025, with Charles Humenry winning the award for the film Lucky Lu.
